root_cause.text: The software accesses the `req` structure (specifically `req->ctx->sec->debug.dfx.send_cnt`) after the request has been submitted to hardware, but the hardware completion callback can free `req` asynchronously, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces `atomic64_inc(&req->ctx->sec->debug.dfx.send_cnt)` with `atomic64_inc(&qp_ctx->ctx->sec->debug.dfx.send_cnt)`, and the CVE description explicitly states that under heavy load, hardware may complete and free `req` before the transmission function finishes, so accessing `req` afterward leads to use-after-free. The `qp_ctx` memory persists throughout the entire packet sending process, avoiding this issue.
